map_tips: World map mein rivers nahi hoti — sirf sea routes, agriculture areas, railways, cities, canals
India map mein arrows se location point karo — naam clearly pen se likho
Cape Town to London route — around S. Africa ka tip (Cape of Good Hope) se north-west
Trans-Siberian = Russia ki railway (Moscow to Vladivostok) — world's longest
Australian Trans-Continental = Perth (west coast) to Sydney (east coast) — horizontal
Suez Canal = NE Egypt between Mediterranean Sea and Red Sea
Panama Canal = Central America between Atlantic Ocean and Pacific Ocean
Bailadila = Chhattisgarh (iron ore) — NOT Jharkhand (common confusion)
Bina oil refinery = Madhya Pradesh — frequently asked in Q20
Amarkantak = Narmada river origin in Madhya Pradesh — NOT Chhattisgarh
Indira Gandhi Canal starts from Harika Barrage in Firozpur, Punjab — not from Rajasthan
Haldia = both oil refinery AND port in West Bengal — dual use site
Neyveli = lignite (brown coal) in Tamil Nadu — NOT in Jharkhand
